description: Ask the app to handle an app-defined automation or test event, with an optional structured payload. Supported event names and payload shapes are defined by the app. Times out after 90s.

device.description: Device name; ids go in udid or serial.

event.description: Name of an app-defined automation or test event the app documents.

payload.description: Structured payload passed to the event, in the shape the app documents for it.

serial.description: Android, HarmonyOS, or Vega VVD serial.

name: trigger-app-event
title: Invoke an app-defined automation event
